jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer, Computer Vision
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Machine Learning Engineer with strong foundations in computer vision and  
  
machine learning, and a practical mindset: you care about making models work on real data, in  
  
real products. Our team builds foundational perception technologies. These models are built  
  
once and reused by many experiences, across iPhone, iPad, Mac, HomeView and more. They  
  
already power Apple Intelligence features such as Visual Intelligence and Clean Up in Photos.  
  
Our work spans a wide range of models, from lightweight, task-specific vision models to  
  
general-purpose vision-language models. In this role, you will build computer vision models and  
  
VLMs that help Apple devices recognize and understand the objects around the user. You will  
  
turn recent research into models that ship on millions of devices.  
  
**Description**  
  
Design, train and improve computer vision and VLM models for object understanding and  
  
recognition.  
  
Make models robust to real-world conditions and across devices and fix failure modes on real  
  
data  
  
Define evaluations that reflect product quality, and use them to drive model decisions.  
  
Design models for on-device constraints (memory, latency, power).  
  
**Preferred Qualifications**  
  
Publications in top computer vision or machine learning venues (CVPR, ICCV, ECCV,  
  
NeurIPS, ICLR), ideally with released code or work transferred to a product.  
  
Experience in representation learning, such as self-supervised learning, metric learning,  
  
retrieval or recognition.  
  
Experience applying machine learning in an industry or product setting.  
  
Experience with knowledge distillation or model compression.  
  
Familiarity with vision-language models.  
  
**Minimum Qualifications**  
  
Ph.D. or Master's in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Computer Vision or a related field,  
  
or equivalent industry experience.  
  
Strong foundations in computer vision and deep learning.  
  
Track record of making models work in practice: end-to-end projects covering data, training  
  
and evaluation on real-world visual data.  
  
Proficiency in Python and PyTorch or an equivalent deep learning framework.  
  
Proficiency in using generative coding tools  
  
Rigorous experimentation: clear baselines, ablations and meaningful evaluation sets.  
  
**Pay & Benefits**  
  
At Apple, base pay is one part of our total compensation package and is determined within a range. This provides the opportunity to progress as you grow and develop within a role. The base pay range for this role is between $150,400 and $277,600, and your base pay will depend on your skills, qualifications, experience, and location.  
  
Apple employees also have the opportunity to become an Apple shareholder through participation in Apple's discretionary employee stock programs. Apple employees are eligible for discretionary restricted stock unit awards, and can purchase Apple stock at a discount if voluntarily participating in Apple's Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You'll also receive benefits including: Comprehensive medical and dental coverage, retirement benefits, a range of discounted products and free services, and for formal education related to advancing your career at Apple, reimbursement for certain educational expenses - including tuition. Additionally, this role might be eligible for discretionary bonuses or commission payments as well as relocation. Learn more about Apple Benefits  
  
Note: Apple benefit, compensation and employee stock programs are subject to eligibility requirements and other terms of the applicable plan or program.

jobs.title: Converge Signals, FSI - Data Scientist_Products & Platforms
jobs.description:
**The Team**  
  
The Innovation & Delivery Transformation (I&DT) team is building the future of Deloitte's business through new AI-native platforms and products. The team is responsible for identifying, nurturing, scaling, and winning in new markets through new capabilities. Rather than relying on what the firm has historically done, I&DT looks ahead and invests in areas where growth is expected three, five, and ten years into the future.  
  
Are you looking for a unique opportunity with both start-up spirit AND enterprise strength? Deloitte's Converge for FSI business offers both! We are looking for a talented **Data Scientist** to join the Converge for FSI team and help build differentiated, data-driven financial services products that achieve product-market fit. This is a great opportunity to work at the intersection of advanced analytics and financial services industry expertise, developing the models and insights that power Signals for FSI and future products in the Converge for FSI portfolio.  
  
**Position Summary**  
  
Financial services data holds enormous, often-underused potential - and turning it into decisions the business can act on takes both rigorous technical craft and real industry fluency. As a Data Scientist on the Signals for FSI team, you'll build the analytical engine behind one of Converge for FSI's flagship products, working hands-on with real financial services data to develop models clients can trust. You'll do it on a team that pairs start-up speed with the scale and credibility of Deloitte, giving you room to experiment while your work reaches some of the most influential institutions in financial services.  
  
Recruiting for this role ends on 12/1/2026.  
  
**Work you'll do**  
  
As the Data Scientist, you will work at the intersection of data science, product, and financial services domain expertise to build and refine the models and analytics that power Signals for FSI:  

* Develop, test, and refine statistical and machine learning models using financial services datasets (e.g., consumers, businesses, transactions, accounts, risk, or market data) to power Signals for FSI.
* Partner with the Product team to translate financial services use cases into data requirements, features, data signals, and model specifications.
* Conduct exploratory data analysis and validate data quality across structured and semi-structured financial services data sources.
* Evaluate model performance against business and regulatory considerations relevant to financial services and iterate based on findings.
* Translate analytical findings into clear, business-relevant insights for Product, Sales, and client-facing teams.
* Stay current on emerging Statistical, AI/ML techniques and financial services data trends, and evaluate their application to the Signals for FSI roadmap.

  
The successful candidate would possess these skills:  

* Genuine interest in and working knowledge of the financial services industry, with curiosity about how data translates into real client outcomes - early use cases are retail banking, investment and wealth management and insurance, but will expand over time.
* Strong analytical rigor paired with sound judgment about when a signal or model is ready to ship versus needing further refinement.
* Comfortable moving between hands-on technical work and clear communication with product, engineering, and business stakeholders.
* Self-directed and organized, with the ability to manage multiple analytical workstreams at once.
* Collaborative mindset and a willingness to partner closely with engineering and product teams to bring models into production.
* Comfortable working through ambiguous, messy problems that require creativity and persistence.

  
**Qualifications**  
  
**Required:**  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Data Science, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field.
* 4+ years of experience in applied data science, machine learning, or statistical modeling, including hands-on model development and validation - proficient at using Python, SQL and other data transformation and analytical tools
* Ability to travel 10-25%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
* Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.

  
**Preferred:**  

* Advanced degree (Master's) in Computer Science, Statistics, Data Science, Mathematics, or a related field.
* 2+ years of experience working with financial services data (e.g., banking, capital markets, investment management, or insurance) or delivering analytics solutions to financial services clients.
* 2+ years of working with customer data to build audiences and segments for sales and marketing use cases.
* Experience with cloud-based data and analytics platforms (e.g., Snowflake, Databricks, AWS, Google Cloud, or Azure) in a financial services or other highly regulated industry context.
* Experience with MCP servers and use of AI to analyze large data sets.

  
The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. Preferred Qualifications
  
  

* Knowledge of production monitoring, incident response, postmortems, and root cause analysis.
* Deep architectural intuition with an API-first mindset.
* Ability to thrive in high-velocity environments, navigating ambiguity to deliver innovative solutions.
* In-depth conceptual and practical knowledge in primary technical job family and knowledge of related technical job families; has worked extensively with a range of technologies.
* Strong background in object-oriented design, data structures, algorithms, testing, and software development principles.
* Experience applying spec-driven development or similar approaches to improve software quality and delivery.

Why Cisco?
  
  
At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
  
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
  
We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

jobs.title: Software Engineer - Applications
jobs.description:
**About Us**
------------

We are a well-funded, early-stage AI research and product lab focused on building the next generation of frontier multimodal AI models. Founded by former DeepMind researchers—including Andrew Dai, previously an engineering leader on Gemini—our mission is to push the frontier of visual and multimodal intelligence. Our first model, Glimpse, launched publicly in October 2026.

Our team currently consists of 25 world-class scientists and engineers. We raised a $55M seed round led by Altimeter Capital, Menlo Ventures, Striker VC, and NVIDIA. We are tackling foundational problems in artificial intelligence and translating cutting-edge multimodal research into scalable, real-world systems.

**About The Role**
------------------

As a **Software Engineer – Applications**, you will build the engineering bridge between our core multimodal research and real-world production deployments. This is an engineering-first, high-impact role where you will design and implement reference architectures, production-grade integration frameworks, developer SDKs, evaluation harnesses, and bespoke end-to-end applications powered by Glimpse.

You will sit at the intersection of product engineering, model evaluation, and customer architecture. Working directly with founders, early enterprise partners, and our internal research team, you will turn complex multimodal requirements into robust, high-performance systems and feed real-world constraints directly into our model roadmaps.

**What You Will Do**
--------------------

* **Architect & Build Production Integrations:** Design, build, and deploy low-latency, scalable application architectures integrating Glimpse into complex enterprise data pipelines and high-throughput workflows.
* **Develop Reference Systems & Tooling:** Create open-source reference implementations, production-ready demo applications, developer tooling, and SDK components that establish the standard for building on Glimpse.
* **Build Evaluation & Benchmarking Infrastructure:** Design and implement rigorous evaluation pipelines and benchmarking harnesses to systematically test Glimpse against other frontier multimodal models on diverse, real-world visual datasets.
* **Debug Across the Stack:** Systematically isolate and resolve bottlenecks across application pipelines, data ingestion layers, model inference APIs, and prompt/orchestration logic.
* **Partner Technically with Early Adopters:** Serve as the core technical architect for engineering teams at design-partner companies, guiding technical discovery, proof-of-concept development, and deployment to production.
* **Influence Model & Platform Roadmaps:** Translate real-world application failure modes, edge cases, and performance requirements into prioritized specifications for our core research and model infrastructure teams.

**What We Are Looking For**
---------------------------

* **Strong Core Engineering:** 5+ years of experience building and shipping high-performance, production software in Python (and ideally TypeScript or Go/Rust). You write clean, maintainable code and can speak deeply to your architectural decisions.
* **Hands-on LLM/Multimodal Application Engineering:** Experience building complex systems beyond basic API calls—such as agentic workflows, structured tool-use frameworks, model evaluation pipelines, or orchestration layers for vision-language models.
* **Model Understanding & Evaluation:** Hands-on experience evaluating, fine-tuning, or benchmarking ML models. You can systematically differentiate between model failure modes, pipeline errors, and data-quality issues.
* **Full-Lifecycle Ownership:** A builder mindset with a bias for shipping quickly. Experience as a founding engineer, startup core contributor, or forward-deployed engineer is highly valued.
* **Systems & Data Architecture:** Familiarity with modern cloud architecture, API design, vector/multimodal indexing, streaming protocols, and handling high-volume image/video data pipelines under tight latency and cost constraints.
* **Clear Technical Communication:** Ability to communicate complex architectural tradeoffs clearly to both internal research teams and external engineering leaders.

**Nice To Have**
----------------

* Prior experience at a foundation model provider, AI developer platform, or ML infrastructure company.
* Direct experience building multimodal applications in vision-heavy verticals (e.g., robotics, industrial automation, manufacturing, geospatial, medical imaging, or media production).
* Experience developing public developer APIs, open-source AI tooling, or developer ecosystems.

**Logistics**
-------------

* **Location:** On-site in Palo Alto, CA
* **Employment Type:** Full-time
* **Compensation**: $250,000 – $400,000 + significant equity + comprehensive health insurance and perks

jobs.title: Deep Learning Compiler Verification Engineer
jobs.description:
NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. It’s a unique legacy of innovation that’s fueled by great technology—and amazing people. Today, we’re tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what’s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work.

  

We are building the next generation of compiler technologies to accelerate deep learning workloads. We are looking for an engineer to implement compiler verification software & related infrastructure in the AI space. You will be solving critical problems working alongside a diverse set of minds in GPU computing and systems software, doing what you enjoy. If this sounds like a fun challenge, we want to hear from you.

  

**What you'll be doing:**

* Develop and maintain components of systems to reason about correctness in deep learning compilers, across graph transformations, IR lowering, and GPU execution.
* Work with deep learning compiler and architecture teams to analyze and validate optimizations (e.g., graph rewrites in MLIR, fusion passes, mixed-precision transformations), ensuring they preserve semantics and numerical behavior.
* Implement and extend test generation systems that use deep learning solutions and analysis methods to drive in-depth testing. These systems explore the vast combinatorial space of model topologies, precision modes, and hardware targets.
Contribute to improving how we measure functional quality and performance as models, compiler stacks, and hardware continue to evolve.  

  

**What we need to see:**

* BS, MS or PhD in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Mathematics, or equivalent experience.
* 2+ years of hands-on software engineering experience, with experience in compiler development, deep learning systems, or compiler verification.
* Proficiency in Python or C++ and experience with one major DL framework. This could be PyTorch, JAX/XLA, TensorRT, or a similar framework. Experience should involve model execution, graph representation, or runtime behavior.
Strong problem-solving and debugging skills — ability to reason about model behavior and compiler-generated code, investigate correctness issues, and collaborate with teammates to resolve edge-case failures.  

  

**Ways to stand out from the crowd:**

* Experience with compiler technologies such as LLVM, MLIR, TVM, or XLA, and familiarity with compiler passes, IR semantics, or correctness testing.
* Exposure to formal methods or language specification: type systems, program semantics, or proof-based verification.
* Experience with DL model internals such as quantization, operator fusion, mixed-precision, or graph-level optimization.

Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and other objective job-related factors. The expected base salary range for this position is 116,000 USD – 189,750 USD.

You will also be eligible for equity and benefits .

Applications for this job will be accepted at least until November 4, 2026.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.

NVIDIA uses AI tools in its recruiting processes.

NVIDIA is committed to fostering an inclusive work environment and proud to be an equal opportunity employer. As we highly value diversity in our current and future employees, we do not discriminate (including in our hiring and promotion practices) on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or any other characteristic protected by law.

jobs.title: AI Research Scientist, Language - Generative AI
jobs.description:
Meta is seeking a Research Scientist to join our Llama Large Language Model (LLM) Research team. We are looking for recognized experts in NLP or reinforcement learning; with experience in areas like LLM alignment; multilingual modeling; code generation; responsible AI; and model controllability. The ideal candidate will have an interest in producing and applying new science to help us develop and responsibly release large language models.  
  
  

### **AI Research Scientist, Language - Generative AI Responsibilities:**

* Lead, collaborate, and execute on research that pushes forward the state of the art in large language model research
* Directly contribute to experiments, including designing experimental details, writing reusable code, running evaluations, and organizing results
* Work with a large and globally distributed team
* Contribute to publications and open-sourcing efforts
* Help identify long-term ambitious research goals as well as intermediate milestones
* Prioritize research that can be applied to Meta's product development
* Mentor other team members. Play a significant role in healthy cross-functional collaboration

  
  
  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, relevant technical field, or equivalent practical experience
* A PhD in AI, computer science, or related technical fields
* Experience holding an industry, faculty, or government researcher position
* Publications in machine learning
* Experience writing software and executing complex experiments involving large AI models and datasets
* Must obtain work authorization in the country of employment at the time of hire, and maintain ongoing work authorization during employment

  
  
  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Direct experience in generative AI and LLM research.
* Experience developing and debugging in Python.
* First author publications experience at peer-reviewed AI conferences (e.g., NeurIPS, CVPR, ICML, ICLR, ICCV, and ACL).
* 2+ year(s) of work experience in a university, industry, or government lab, in a role with primary emphasis on AI research.

  
  
  

### **About Meta:**

Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. Now, Meta is moving beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next evolution in social technology. People who choose to build their careers by building with us at Meta help shape a future that will take us beyond what digital connection makes possible today—beyond the constraints of screens, the limits of distance, and even the rules of physics.  
  
  

Meta is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Meta participates in the E-Verify program in certain locations, as required by law. Please note that Meta may leverage artificial intelligence and machine learning technologies in connection with applications for employment.
  
  
Meta is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities in our recruiting process. If you need any assistance or accommodations due to a disability, please let us know at accommodations-ext@meta.com.  
  
$154,000/year to $217,000/year + bonus + equity + benefits  
  
Individual compensation is determined by skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Compensation details listed in this posting reflect the base hourly rate, monthly rate, or annual salary only, and do not include bonus, equity or sales incentives, if applicable. In addition to base compensation, Meta offers benefits. Learn more about benefits at Meta.
